row.notes: Whole body read: state machine on job+0x44. State 0 -> 7 (done). State 2: waits while the IO request at +8 is busy (+8 == 1 or +0x48 == 1), then sets state 7, swaps the request buffer (+0x30/+0x38) into job+0x48/+0x50, destroys and frees the request, and when a buffer or job+0x1f0 exists allocates a 0x30-byte free task (vtable 0x1458c4160) and appends it to the worker-set queue (job+0x58 -> +0xa8..+0xb8), state 6; on allocation failure logs 'Unable to push streaming job to worker set' and frees the buffer directly. State 6: when the task (+0x28) is no longer running, state 7 and the task is freed. Caller Render_TextureStreaming_ComputeDeficitStep calls it instead of StepLoadMips/StepReduceMips when the job cancel flag (job+0x30) is set. Caller 0x143ebc270: steps every job in the streaming lists (+0x300, +0x348, +0x390, +0x3d8) and unlinks jobs that reach state 7. (lab L1 re-check with caller context 2026-11-27)
